en.headline: Chan urges Airport Authority to recast 11 Skies as tourism landmark
en.dek: The transport secretary said the mega complex should be upgraded for transit passengers after New World returns it next April.
body: Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said on Saturday that the Airport Authority should set a clear direction and timetable to reposition 11 Skies after it takes the project back next April, RTHK reported.

The comments followed an agreement under which New World Development will end the sublease and return the complex to the authority on 1 April 2027. HK01 reported that New World will also pay the authority about HK$3.3 billion in compensation and construction costs, and that the site covers more than 3.8 million square feet.

Speaking on a Commercial Radio programme, Chan said she hoped the authority would set up a dedicated subsidiary and team able to respond to the market, especially transit passengers. She said space now used mainly as offices, shops and restaurants should be upgraded into high-end tourism offerings with experiential activities, in line with the airport city plan, RTHK reported.

Chan said the work also needs to fit the opening of the airport's Terminal 2 by the end of 2027, the second phase of AsiaWorld-Expo in 2028, and the use of driverless vehicles. On the southbound yacht scheme expected to start this month, she said berthing and onshore facilities were being prepared, the Marine Department had a real-time yacht monitoring system and five designated anchorage zones, and it was working with the Guangdong maritime authority on facilitation measures.

zh.headline: 陳美寶促機管局盡快為11 SKIES定路向
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長指，新世界明年4月交還項目後，應升級為配合過境旅客的高階旅遊設施。
body: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶周六表示，機管局明年4月接管11 SKIES後，應盡快訂出清晰方向和時間表，重新定位有關項目。港台報道了她在商台節目的說法。
有關言論是在新世界發展與機管局達成協議、將於2027年4月1日終止分租並交還項目之後。香港01報道，新世界同時向機管局支付約33億元補償及工程費用，項目總面積超過380萬平方呲。
陳美寶說，希望機管局成立專責附屬公司及團隊，能按市場需要回應，尤其是過境旅客。她指出，現時以辦公室、零售及餐飲為主的空間，應升級為具體驗活動的高階旅遊設施，以配合機場城市的整體規劃。
她又說，重新規劃須配合2027年年底啟用的二號客運大樓、2028年落成的亞洲國際博覽館第二期，以及無人駕駛車輛。至於預計本月推出的遊艇南下計劃，她表示政府正準備泊位及岸上設施；海事處已設立遊艇實時監察系統並劃定五個錨地，並正與廣東海事部門研究便利措施。
